title: Route
subtitle: Route = the way, path, or course used or planned for travelling from one place to another.
description: Route = the way, path, or course used or planned for travelling from one place to another. 但不同語境會分成 physical path, direction/course, everyday way, planned itinerary, public-transport line, passage through a constrained area, 或 technical trajectory。

words.example: The hikers followed a narrow path through the forest.
words.exampleZh: 遠足人士沿着一條狹窄小徑穿過森林。

exercises.original: The route through the woods becomes narrow after the bridge.
exercises.zh: 穿過樹林的路線在橋後變窄。
exercises.upgrade: The path through the woods becomes narrow after the bridge.

options.explanation: Path ✓ — the way or track along which someone or something moves。本句關鍵是 a physical walking track is central；因此 Path 最精準。
Way — a means or route for getting from one place to another。way 是最廣的日常用語，適合一般問路；若句子涉及航向、行程表、鐵路線或技術軌跡，另有更精準詞。
Course — the route or direction followed by a ship, aircraft, river, or moving object。course 強調方向／行進線；一般日常問路或公共交通服務未必自然。
Direction — the orientation in which something moves or faces。direction 只表示朝哪個方向，不提供完整路線。
Destination — the place to which someone or something is going。destination 是終點，不是到達終點的路線。
Road — a physical road for vehicles。road 是一條實體道路；一條 route 可以由多條道路或不同交通段組成。

Destination — the place to which someone or something is going。destination 是終點，不是到達終點的路線。
Road — a physical road for vehicles。road 是一條實體道路；一條 route 可以由多條道路或不同交通段組成。

exercises.original: A slight error changed the rocket's route.
exercises.zh: 一個輕微錯誤改變了火箭的軌跡。
exercises.upgrade: A slight error changed the rocket's trajectory.

options.explanation: Course — the route or direction followed by a ship, aircraft, river, or moving object。course 強調方向／行進線；一般日常問路或公共交通服務未必自然。
Path — the way or track along which someone or something moves。path 偏實際移動線／小徑；若句子是旅行行程、鐵路服務或穿越受限區域，另有更精準詞。
Trajectory ✓ — the path followed by a moving object through space。本句關鍵是 technical path of a moving object is central；因此 Trajectory 最精準。
Direction — the orientation in which something moves or faces。direction 只表示朝哪個方向，不提供完整路線。
Destination — the place to which someone or something is going。destination 是終點，不是到達終點的路線。
Road — a physical road for vehicles。road 是一條實體道路；一條 route 可以由多條道路或不同交通段組成。

falseSynonyms.zh: 方向 ≠ route direction 只說朝哪個方向，不等於完整路線。
目的地 ≠ route destination 是終點，不是到達終點的路線。
道路 ≠ route road 是實體道路；route 可以由多條道路組成。
軌道／小徑 ≠ all route track 可指軌道、痕跡、小徑或賽道，不是全面同義詞。
只在旅遊行程規劃 sense 接近 itinerary 還包含停站和時間安排。
只在公共交通線 sense 接近 line 常用於鐵路／地鐵等固定服務。
只在物體運動軌跡 sense 接近 trajectory 是技術／科學用語。
詞性與用法陷阱 route 可作名詞，也可作動詞：route traffic / route a call。
